title: WorldCast: World-Consistent Character Video Generation with Large-Angle Camera Control
title_zh: WorldCast：具有大角度相机控制的世界一致角色视频生成

paragraphs.en: Precise camera control is essential for cinematic character video generation, yet existing methods struggle to follow large-angle trajectories with combined rotation, translation, and radius variation from arbitrary initial azimuths. Such viewpoint changes also reveal character regions unseen in the initial frame, causing geometric distortions, appearance degradation, and identity drift. To systematically study these coupled challenges, we introduce CLACT , a large-scale C haracter-centric dataset and benchmark covering diverse L arge- A ngle C amera T rajectories , with accurate camera geometry and multi-view character observations for training and evaluation. We further propose WorldCast , a framework for world-consistent character video generation under diverse large-angle camera motions . Specifically, we back-project the initial frame into a 3D point cloud using estimated depth, align the point-cloud scale with the target camera trajectory, and render it along the trajectory to obtain explicit geometric guidance and coverage masks. To complement the incomplete character information, we introduce Geometry-Aligned Memory Attention (GAMA). Using relative camera poses estimated jointly from the initial frame and multi-view character anchors, we express anchor and target-view geometry in a common coordinate frame. GAMA uses this geometric alignment to guide the retrieval and injection of view-relevant character features during generation. Evaluations across diverse large-angle camera trajectories demonstrate accurate trajectory following while preserving character geometry, appearance, and identity.
paragraphs.zh: 精确的相机控制对于电影级角色视频生成至关重要，然而现有方法难以遵循包含旋转、平移和半径变化的组合以及任意初始方位角的大角度轨迹。 此类视角变化还会揭示初始帧中未曾出现的角色区域，导致几何畸变、外观退化以及身份漂移。 为了系统地研究这些相互耦合的挑战，我们提出了 CLACT，一个大规模的以角色为中心的数据集与基准，涵盖多样化的大角度相机轨迹（L arge- A ngle C amera T rajectories），并提供精确的相机几何与多视角角色观测用于训练和评估。 我们进一步提出了 WorldCast，一个在多样化大角度相机运动下实现世界一致角色视频生成的框架。 具体而言，我们利用估计的深度将初始帧反投影为 3D 点云，将点云尺度与目标相机轨迹对齐，并沿轨迹渲染点云，从而获得显式的几何引导与覆盖掩码。 为了补全不完整的角色信息，我们引入了几何对齐记忆注意力（Geometry-Aligned Memory Attention，GAMA）。 利用从初始帧和多视角角色锚点联合估计的相对相机位姿，我们将锚点与目标视角的几何表达在同一坐标系中。 GAMA 利用这种几何对齐来引导在生成过程中检索并注入与视角相关的角色特征。 在多样化大角度相机轨迹上的评估表明，我们的方法能够精确遵循轨迹，同时保持角色的几何、外观与身份。

paragraphs.en: Recent video diffusion models have achieved remarkable visual fidelity in text- and image-conditioned video generation [ 1 , 2 ] . For cinematic content creation, however, visual quality alone is insufficient: creators also require precise control over camera motion [ 3 ] . In character-centric videos, camera motion can reveal a subject from different viewpoints, establish spatial relationships, and direct visual attention. Realizing such shots therefore requires not only accurate trajectory following, but also consistent preservation of character geometry, appearance, and identity across substantial viewpoint changes [ 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的视频扩散模型在文本和图像条件下的视频生成中已取得了出色的视觉保真度 [1, 2]。 然而，对于影视内容创作而言，仅凭视觉质量是不够的：创作者还需要对镜头运动进行精确控制 [3]。 在以角色为中心的视频中，镜头运动可以从不同视角展现主体、建立空间关系，并引导视觉注意力。 因此，实现这类镜头不仅需要精确的轨迹跟随，还需要在大幅视角变化下始终如一地保持角色的几何结构、外观与身份一致性 [4]。

paragraphs.en: Camera-controlled video generation has progressed from camera-pose and ray-based conditioning to explicit geometric guidance derived from 3D renderings [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] . Recent methods further explore joint appearance-depth modeling and more expressive camera representations to support complex camera motions [ 10 , 11 ] . Meanwhile, multi-view generation and video re-rendering provide complementary means of improving cross-view consistency and synthesizing novel viewpoints [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] . Despite this progress, accurate trajectory following and consistent character generation remain difficult under large viewpoint changes.
paragraphs.zh: 相机可控视频生成已从基于相机位姿和射线的条件控制，发展到利用 3D 渲染得到的显式几何引导 [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] 。 近期方法进一步探索外观与深度的联合建模以及更具表达力的相机表示，以支持复杂的相机运动 [ 10 , 11 ] 。 与此同时，多视图生成与视频重渲染为提升跨视图一致性和合成新视角提供了互补的手段 [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] 。 尽管取得了这些进展，在大视角变化下实现精确的轨迹跟随和一致的角色生成仍然十分困难。

paragraphs.en: Large-angle camera motion introduces two closely coupled challenges. First, trajectories involving substantial rotation together with translation, radius variation, and arbitrary initial azimuths place significantly stronger demands on camera control. Limited trajectory coverage or inaccurate geometric conditioning can result in under-rotation, incorrect translation, and drift from the requested path [ 16 ] . Second, the same viewpoint changes progressively expose character regions that are unobserved in the initial frame, leaving their geometry, appearance, and identity weakly constrained [ 17 , 18 ] . These challenges are inherently linked: the target camera trajectory determines both the geometry that the generated video must follow and the previously unseen character content that must be synthesized at each viewpoint. Explicit geometric guidance can constrain the former, while multi-view character observations provide complementary evidence for the latter. Effectively combining them therefore requires relating both sources of information to the target viewpoints within a shared geometric reference frame.
paragraphs.zh: 大角度的相机运动带来两个紧密耦合的挑战。 首先，同时涉及大幅旋转与平移、半径变化以及任意初始方位角的轨迹，对相机控制提出了显著更高的要求。 轨迹覆盖不足或几何条件不准确，可能导致旋转不足、平移错误以及偏离请求的路径 [ 16 ] 。 其次，相同的视点变化会逐渐暴露出初始帧中未被观察到的角色区域，使其几何、外观和身份受到较弱约束 [ 17 , 18 ] 。 这些挑战本质上是相互关联的：目标相机轨迹既决定了生成的视频必须遵循的几何，也决定了必须在每个视点合成的先前未被看到的角色内容。 显式的几何引导可以约束前者，而多视角角色观察则为后者提供补充证据。 因此，有效结合二者需要在一个共享的几何参考系中，将这两类信息都与目标视点相关联。

paragraphs.en: Existing data remain insufficient for systematically studying and evaluating large-angle character-centric camera control. Current camera-motion datasets provide limited coverage of complex trajectories involving substantial rotation, translation, radius variation, and diverse initial azimuths [ 19 , 14 ] . Moreover, camera-motion sequences are not consistently paired with complementary views of the same character, limiting the joint study of trajectory accuracy and cross-view character consistency [ 18 , 20 ] . To address these limitations, we construct CLACT , a character-centric dataset and benchmark designed for diverse large-angle camera motion. Its training corpus contains 50,000 50{,}000 camera-motion sequences rendered in Unreal Engine 5 and 30,000 30{,}000 Blender-rendered samples with multi-view character anchors, while the evaluation set covers 42 42 synthetic and real-world character scenes under multiple trajectory families. Together, these data support both training and systematic evaluation of trajectory accuracy, character consistency, and visual quality across diverse camera motions and substantial viewpoint changes.
paragraphs.zh: 现有数据仍不足以系统性地研究和评估以角色为中心的大角度相机控制。 当前的相机运动数据集对涉及大幅度旋转、平移、半径变化和多样初始方位角的复杂轨迹覆盖有限 [ 19 , 14 ] 。 此外，相机运动序列并未始终与同一角色的互补视图配对，这限制了轨迹精度与跨视图角色一致性的联合研究 [ 18 , 20 ] 。 为解决这些局限，我们构建了 CLACT，一个面向多样化大角度相机运动的以角色为中心的数据集与基准。 其训练语料包含 50,000 50{,}000 条在 Unreal Engine 5 中渲染的相机运动序列，以及 30,000 30{,}000 个带有多视图角色锚点的 Blender 渲染样本，而评估集涵盖多种轨迹族下的 42 42 个合成与真实角色场景。 这些数据共同支持对轨迹精度、角色一致性和视觉质量在多样化相机运动与大幅视角变化下的训练与系统评估。

paragraphs.en: Camera-controlled video generation incorporates explicit motion conditions into video diffusion models. MotionCtrl disentangles camera and object motion, while CameraCtrl introduces camera conditioning [ 5 , 7 ] . CamCo and CamI2V incorporate camera geometry and epipolar constraints into cross-frame modeling [ 21 , 6 ] . VD3D and AC3D extend camera conditioning to video diffusion transformers [ 22 , 23 ] , while UCPE unifies camera pose, intrinsics, distortion, and orientation in a common representation [ 10 ] . DualCamCtrl couples RGB and depth generation to strengthen adherence to camera conditions [ 11 ] . For video re-rendering, ReCamMaster, DepthDirector, and CameraAnything generate new camera trajectories while preserving source content and dynamics [ 14 , 24 , 15 ] .

paragraphs.en: Geometric representations and complementary observations provide spatial constraints for viewpoint synthesis. 3DiM, GeNVS, and CAT3D study novel-view synthesis from one or a few observations [ 25 , 26 , 27 ] , while ViewCrafter, MVGenMaster, and SEVA leverage geometry or multiple input views to synthesize target viewpoints [ 17 , 13 , 12 ] . paragraphs.en: Subject-conditioned video generation seeks to preserve appearance and identity across generated frames. VideoBooth and DreamVideo introduce subject-specific conditioning [ 30 , 31 ] , while ConsisID and Magic-Me develop mechanisms for identity preservation [ 32 , 33 ] . ConsID-Gen uses complementary views to improve cross-view consistency, and Gloria represents character appearance through content anchors [ 18 , 4 ] . Virtually Being combines identity preservation across viewpoints with camera control through customization based on performance captures [ 34 ] . We jointly address character consistency and large-angle camera control through geometric guidance and view-aware retrieval from multi-view character memory.
paragraphs.zh: 主体条件化的视频生成旨在在生成的帧之间保持外观与身份的一致性。 VideoBooth 与 DreamVideo 引入了特定主体的条件机制 [ 30 , 31 ] ，而 ConsisID 与 Magic-Me 开发了身份保持机制 [ 32 , 33 ] 。 ConsID-Gen 利用互补视角来提升跨视角一致性，Gloria 则通过内容锚点来表示角色外观 [ 18 , 4 ] 。 Virtually Being 通过基于表演捕捉的定制化，将跨视角的身份保持与摄像机控制相结合 [ 34 ] 。 我们通过几何引导和基于多视角角色记忆的视角感知检索，联合解决角色一致性与大角度摄像机控制问题。

paragraphs.en: 1 , WorldCast achieves superior camera control and character consistency while maintaining competitive visual quality. The gains span trajectory accuracy, cross-view geometry, and identity and appearance preservation. Additional reference views yield limited or inconsistent improvements for ViewCrafter and MVGenMaster, reflecting the difficulty of reliably aligning sparse cross-view geometry under large viewpoint changes. paragraphs.en: We presented CLACT , a character-centric dataset and benchmark for large-angle camera-controlled video generation, together with WorldCast , a framework that jointly improves trajectory accuracy and character preservation under substantial viewpoint changes. The key idea is to combine scale-aligned geometric guidance with Geometry-Aligned Memory Attention (GAMA), which aligns multi-view character observations with the target camera geometry and retrieves view-relevant character features during generation. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world scenes demonstrate more accurate camera control and stronger preservation of character geometry, appearance, and identity, while maintaining competitive visual quality. Ablation studies further confirm the importance of large-angle training data, explicit camera-ray conditioning, geometric anchor alignment, and multi-view character memory. Future work will explore more flexible anchor acquisition, more complex dynamic scenes, and longer or interactive camera trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了CLACT，一个面向大角度相机控制视频生成的以角色为中心的数据集与基准，并同时提出WorldCast，一个在大幅视角变化下共同提升轨迹精度与角色一致性的框架。 其核心思想是将尺度对齐的几何引导与几何对齐记忆注意力（GAMA）相结合，该机制将多视角的角色观测与目标相机几何对齐，并在生成过程中检索与视角相关的角色特征。 在合成场景与真实场景上的实验表明，本方法实现了更精确的相机控制，并更强地保留了角色的几何、外观与身份，同时保持了具有竞争力的视觉质量。 消融研究进一步验证了大角度训练数据、显式相机光线条件、几何锚点对齐以及多视角角色记忆的重要性。 未来的工作将探索更灵活的锚点获取方式、更复杂的动态场景，以及更长或交互式的相机轨迹。

paragraphs.en: This work studies controllable character video generation and therefore has potential applications in visual-content creation as well as potential risks associated with synthetic human imagery. Our training benchmark is constructed primarily from controlled simulations using licensed or publicly available 3D character and environment assets. Any released real-world evaluation data will exclude personally identifiable private individuals and will follow the applicable data licenses and usage terms. Although our method is designed for research on camera control and character consistency, character-generation technology could be misused to create misleading or impersonating content. We therefore discourage the synthesis of deceptive depictions of real individuals without their knowledge or consent and will provide provenance and documentation for released benchmark assets and generated examples where applicable.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作研究可控角色视频生成，因此在视觉内容创作方面具有潜在应用价值，同时也存在与合成人物图像相关的潜在风险。 我们的训练基准主要基于受控仿真构建，使用的是已授权或公开可用的3D角色与环境资产。 任何发布真实世界评估数据时，都将排除可识别个人身份的私人个体，并遵循适用的数据许可与使用条款。 尽管我们的方法旨在用于相机控制与角色一致性研究，角色生成技术仍可能被滥用于制作误导性或冒充性内容。 因此，我们不鼓励在未经真实个人知情或同意的情况下合成具有欺骗性的其形象描述，并在适用情况下为发布的基准资产和生成示例提供来源信息与文档。

paragraphs.en: We generate 30,000 30{,}000 samples using an automated Blender pipeline with Cycles rendering. The assets include indoor and outdoor environments as well as static, rigged, and animated characters. The pipeline computes scene bounds, rescales characters, and evaluates candidate placements based on ground height, visibility, and clearance. Character placement and camera framing are adjusted to maintain ground contact and keep the subject within view. Orbit centers are derived from the placed character geometry, while camera radius and focal length are selected according to character size and scene constraints.

paragraphs.en: Each synthetic or real-world scene is evaluated under six prescribed camera trajectories covering large-angle orbits, pure translations, and combined rotation–translation motions. These trajectories span substantial viewpoint changes and diverse initial azimuths, varying the character content observed in the initial view and enabling joint evaluation of trajectory adherence and character consistency as previously unseen regions become visible.
paragraphs.zh: 每个合成场景或真实场景均在六条规定的相机轨迹下进行评估，这些轨迹涵盖大角度环绕、纯平移以及旋转—平移组合运动。 这些轨迹涵盖显著的视角变化和多样的初始方位角，改变了初始视图中观察到的角色内容，并使得在先前未见区域变得可见时，能够联合评估轨迹遵循度与角色一致性。

paragraphs.en: For novel-view synthesis methods, we evaluate both their native single-image setting and, where supported, a multi-image setting with character anchors. For the latter, we follow each method’s native multi-view formulation and provide the initial image together with the character anchors as reference views. Target views are then synthesized along the prescribed camera trajectory. This setting allows us to separately examine the effect of additional reference observations when comparing with our multi-view character conditioning.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate each method along three complementary dimensions: camera-control accuracy, character consistency, and visual quality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们沿三个互补的维度评估每种方法：相机控制精度、角色一致性和视觉质量。

paragraphs.en: We recover the camera trajectory of each generated video using Depth Anything 3 [ 51 ] . To remove the global coordinate-frame and scale ambiguity of monocular pose estimation, we align each predicted trajectory to its target trajectory using a Sim(3) Umeyama transformation. Following standard trajectory-evaluation practice [ 43 ] , we compute Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE), Relative Translation Error (RTE), and Relative Rotation Error (RRE). ATE measures the RMSE between aligned and target camera centers, while RTE and RRE measure the translational and rotational errors of consecutive relative poses, respectively. Lower values indicate better camera adherence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Depth Anything 3 [51] 恢复每个生成视频的相机轨迹。 为消除单目位姿估计的全局坐标系与尺度歧义，我们使用 Sim(3) Umeyama 变换将每条预测轨迹对齐到其目标轨迹。 遵循标准的轨迹评估实践 [43]，我们计算绝对轨迹误差（ATE）、相对平移误差（RTE）和相对旋转误差（RRE）。 ATE 衡量对齐后相机中心与目标相机中心之间的均方根误差（RMSE），而 RTE 和 RRE 分别衡量连续相对位姿的平移误差和旋转误差。 数值越低表示相机一致性越好。

paragraphs.en: We use MEt3R [ 44 ] to measure cross-view geometric consistency using all generated frames together with the four observation anchors. We further evaluate identity and appearance consistency using ArcFace [ 45 ] , CLIP [ 46 ] , and DINO [ 47 ] similarities. To account for large viewpoint changes, for each generated frame, we select the observation anchor with the closest camera pose and compute its similarity to that anchor. The resulting similarities are averaged over all frames and videos. Higher ArcFace, CLIP, and DINO similarities indicate stronger consistency, while lower MEt3R indicates better geometric consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 MEt3R [ 44 ] 将所有生成帧与四个观测锚点一起测量跨视角几何一致性。 我们进一步使用 ArcFace [ 45 ]、CLIP [ 46 ] 和 DINO [ 47 ] 相似度来评估身份与外观一致性。 为了考虑较大的视角变化，对于每个生成帧，我们选择相机位姿最接近的观测锚点，并计算其与该锚点的相似度。 最终的相似度在所有帧和视频上取平均。 ArcFace、CLIP 和 DINO 相似度越高表示一致性越强，而 MEt3R 越低表示几何一致性越好。
